title: Is E2B Pro ready to be our sandbox platform?
tldr: Yes for a two-person team today, unless you need GPUs or data residency: E2B Pro meets the isolation, session and cost needs at ~$481 a month for 2,000 sandbox-hours, and its 100-sandbox concurrency cap, not price, is the first wall.
notes: Prices accessed 2026-10-18; FX assumption 1 EUR = 1.16 USD; reference sandbox 2 vCPU / 4 GiB
